Biomarker quantitation
Your trusted partner in biomarker quantitation. With SCIEX, you get innovative solutions backed by a legacy of accuracy and precision.
Whether high or low abundance, from trace levels to trusted data, count on SCIEX for the accuracy your biomarker quantitation demands.

Navigate biomarker quantitation with confidence, exploring the potential of trusted LC-MS/MS solutions designed to simplify and accelerate your workflow. From lab-tested methods to innovative hardware and software, move drug candidates through the pipeline with efficiency and reliability, so you can confidently characterize and quantify, including low-abundant ions, faster than ever before.
Easy-to-use, integrated software streamlines the process, while dependable expert support ensures you can refine workflows and advance promising candidates without hesitation.
Workflow

Our systems provide in-depth coverage that enables you to characterize and confidently quantify biomarkers, even low abundant ions. With different technology options for specific needs, SCIEX can help you get the answers you need.
Accelerate biomarker quantitation with high-sensitivity LC-MS/MS solutions that deliver reliable data in hours, not days.
Confidently characterize and quantify small biomarkers with robust, high-sensitivity LC-MS/MS analyses.
Achieve accurate, precise and reproducible measurements even at low concentrations.
Always have expert support on hand with dependable service at your fingertips.
Be audit-ready with streamlined, compliance-ready software

Technical note Sensitive bioanalysis of galactosyl sphingosine (GalSPH) and glucosyl sphingosine (GluSPH) in cerebral spinal fluid Sensitivity for 2 glycosphingolipids (GluSPH and GalSPH) was evaluated in cerebral spinal fluid using the SCIEX 7500 system. An assay was developed using HILIC chromatography along with positive MRM analysis and electrospray ionization. Calibration curves were generated on the SCIEX 7500 system and the QTRAP 6500+ system to assess the sensitivity difference.
